_meta.purpose: Everything on this site that could not be confirmed from a primary source, or that a primary source contradicts. Published so it can be reviewed after launch rather than buried.
_meta.rule: A flag is not an error in the build. It is a gap in the evidence. Unverified values are printed as 'Not confirmed' on the site; they are never estimated.

flags.title: No prices are shown anywhere on this site
flags.finding: Prices were observed on every listing on 2026-11-20. None are printed here. Amazon's Program Policies allow a site to show price and availability only when Amazon serves the link containing that data, or when the data comes from the Creators API / PA API. This site is static and uses neither.
flags.impact: Readers must click through to see a price. That is the compliant behaviour, not an omission.
flags.action_to_close: Obtain PA API / Creators API access, then render price from an API response with the required attribution.

flags.title: Tracking ID shopnow047c-20 is unverified
flags.finding: The tag was supplied by the site owner and matches the XXXXX-## format Amazon describes. Enrollment status, account store and click history are not publicly observable and were not confirmed.
flags.impact: If the account is not approved, no link on this site can earn. This is the highest-priority unknown.
flags.action_to_close: Sign in to Associates Central → Account Settings and record the tag exactly as shown.

flags.title: The five supplied short links do not expose a tag parameter
flags.finding: Each link.amazon short link was followed once. All five resolved to the correct amazon.com/dp/<ASIN> page. None of the landing URLs contained tag=shopnow047c-20; they carried Amazon's own page-share token (btn_ref=srctok-…). We are not claiming these links are invalid, and we are not claiming they are compliant. Their exact status is unresolved.
flags.impact: Attribution cannot be confirmed from the outside. A 48-hour click test settles it.
flags.action_to_close: Follow Q03: one click from a clean device, then check the Associates click report for the tag.
flags.source_label: Associates Program Policies §2(b) — Special Links must carry the tag

flags.title: One Amazon listing contradicts itself on capacity and preset count
flags.finding: Emeril Lagasse B09B7SB46R. Title: '26QT' and '24 One-Touch Preset Options'. Bullet list: '26-quart' and '25 COOKING PRE-SETS'. Spec table: 'Capacity 24.6 liters'. 26 US quarts ≈ 24.6 L, so capacity is consistent across units — but the preset count is 24 in two places and 25 in a third.
flags.impact: The site prints the contradiction instead of choosing a number. Preset count is not used in any recommendation.
flags.action_to_close: Check the manufacturer's own product page or the printed manual for the exact model.

flags.title: Chefman 8-quart wattage is contradictory
flags.finding: Chefman B08DKYBTPH. The Amazon bullet list ends '1000 Watts/120 Volts – RJ38-SQSS-8T'. Third-party listings for the same model number state 1700 W. No first-party page was found that resolves it.
flags.impact: The wattage field is left blank on the product page rather than filled with either number. This matters for anyone checking circuit load.
flags.action_to_close: Read the rating label in the manufacturer's user guide PDF for RJ38-SQSS-8T.

flags.title: No analytics endpoint exists, and Pages cannot host one
flags.finding: A 'self-hosted analytics endpoint' was specified. GitHub Pages serves static files only and cannot execute server code. The event layer in assets/analytics.js is written, documents its five events, and ships disabled with endpoint = null.
flags.impact: The campaign ledger is defined and empty. No conversion or revenue figures are presented anywhere on the site.
flags.action_to_close: Choose a home for the endpoint (see SG-02) and set window.WINA_CONFIG.endpoint.
flags.source_label: GitHub Docs — What is GitHub Pages?

flags.title: Unit mismatch on the Chefman dual-basket listing
flags.finding: Chefman B0CDY277D3. Title and bullets say 6 quart (two 3-quart baskets). The page's own spec table lists capacity as '6 liters'. 6 US quarts ≈ 5.68 L.
flags.impact: The site quotes the quart figure because it is used three times on the page, and prints this note directly beneath it.
flags.action_to_close: Confirm against the packaging or the Chefman model page for RJ38-SQPF-3TDB-2.

flags.title: Brand and store attribution differ on the Emeril listing
flags.finding: B09B7SB46R is titled 'Emeril Lagasse' but the page's seller/store block is labelled 'Innovation IQ'. The brand shown in the buy box is not the brand in the title.
flags.impact: The site names the product by its title and does not assert a manufacturer. Warranty and support path should be confirmed by the buyer before purchase.
flags.action_to_close: Check the 'Sold by' field at checkout, and confirm who honours the warranty.

flags.title: Star ratings and review counts are point-in-time, not live
flags.finding: All rating figures were read once on 2026-11-20 and stamped with observed_at. They change daily. The site also relays Amazon's own 'bought in past month' text, which is Amazon's claim, not a measurement we made.
flags.impact: Every rating on the site carries its observation timestamp. No rating is presented as current.
flags.action_to_close: Set a refresh interval (SG-08) or replace with API-sourced data.

flags.title: No traffic, conversion or revenue data exists
flags.finding: There is no Search Console property, no analytics endpoint, no RSS subscriber count and no campaign ledger entry. Nothing has been measured because nothing has been instrumented.
flags.impact: The site makes no performance claims of any kind. The ledger in data/ledger.json is structurally complete and numerically empty.
flags.action_to_close: SG-02 (analytics) and SG-10 (Search Console), then populate the ledger from authorized first-party reports only.
flags.source_label: Google Search Console Help — performance reports
